root_idea.summary: The root centers on loss, ruin, and perdition, especially sustained or resulting loss; a separately reported branch concerns becoming ready, orderly, or settled.
root_idea.development: The lexical evidence develops from suffering loss to causing loss and the state of ruin. A qualified secondary branch uses استتبّ for becoming orderly or ready, while its relation to the loss branch is treated as uncertain.

senses.definition: To suffer loss, ruin, or perdition; to perish.
senses.usage_conditions: A Form I perfect verb expressing the subject’s coming to ruin or enduring loss.

senses.definition: To be ruined or perish in the imprecation تَبَّتْ يَدَاهُ, “may his hands perish.”
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, the hands can represent the person as a whole, including his worldly and ultimate good; this is an idiomatic imprecation rather than a restriction to hands as an object.
A noun denoting a continuing state or outcome of loss and destruction, as in being in ruin.

senses.definition: Causing loss or ruin; bringing about perdition.
senses.usage_conditions: A Form II verbal noun expressing the infliction or production of loss, including the Quranic construction meaning that an action increased people only in loss.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Loss or diminution; being lost; perdition or death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal or infinitival form associated with the loss branch of the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut or cut off a thing.
To become old, through the loss of youth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative usage based on the loss of youth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to suffer loss or become lost; to destroy or kill.
An imprecation of loss, perdition, or death upon someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as an imprecatory expression, as in تَبًّا له.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To weaken or impair someone’s strength.
To become orderly, rightly arranged, complete, or settled; of a road, to become well-trodden and easy or direct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Form X branch applied either to a road or to an affair that reaches a proper, regular state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A difficult or distressing state or condition.
A place of perdition or destruction; also, a desert.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal or extended lexical usage; the feminine form is also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An ass or camel having galls or sores on its back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage referring to an animal with back sores.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a road, well-trodden and clearly manifest; figuratively, of an affair, clear and in proper order.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial adjective related to the reported Form X branch.

cautions: The Lane material is indexed under the contracted two-letter heading تب and includes distinct derived and dialectal headwords; those lexical identities have been kept separate where materially relevant.
The relation of اِسْتَتَبَّ to the loss branch is qualified in the evidence, so its orderly or settled meanings remain Classical Arabic meanings rather than being merged into the Quranic ruin senses.
A reported تَبُّوب sense meaning “what the ribs infold” is treated as a likely orthographic confusion with تَابُوت and is not assigned to this root.
